reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000941 (the melody read from 000941a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. George W. Chadwick's dates (1854–1931) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Chadwick_George (G. W. Chadwick, 1854-1931; PEACE, 1893); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Whitefield_Chadwick agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1893. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000941a.nwc). The tune ends on Eb, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
